title_zh: 给窗边幼苗留出合适空间

scenario.goal_zh: 根据种子包装说明和当前光照确定花盆与幼苗安排

context_zh: 纳迪娅在家育苗，朋友费利克斯和她一起查看种子包装说明，决定花盆位置和间距。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: The packet says one seed per pot, but I put three in this one. Now all three have sprouted.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: There's another empty pot here. Let's follow the spacing instructions rather than crowd them together.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: The soil is still damp. Should I leave the pots on this windowsill?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Yes, that's the bright spot the packet recommends. Plants here tend to lean towards the window, so we can watch how these grow.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Will they survive outside yet? The nights are still cold.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: The packet says to wait until after the last frost. Let's keep them inside for now.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: All right. I'll separate the extra seedlings into their own pots and leave enough space between them.
